title: geranium atrum
intro: Geranium atrum, commonly known as the Black Rose Geranium, is a plant species within the Geraniaceae family, characterized by its dark red to almost black flowers and unique appearance. The Black Rose Geranium has been utilized in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties, supporting wound healing and immune system function. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to promote relaxation, reduce anxiety and stress, and regulate hormonal imbalances, making it a popular choice in aromatherapy and herbal medicine. The bioactive constituents responsible for these properties include geraniol, linalool, and β-caryophyllene, which contribute to the plant's bioactivity and potential therapeutic applications.
